# Imported application dependencies

Pinned browser distributions used by projects imported from `matheweon.github.io`:

| File | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jquery-3.7.1.min.js` | 3.7.1 | https://jquery.com/ |
| `jquery-ui-1.13.3.min.js` | 1.13.3 | https://jqueryui.com/ |
| `d3-7.9.0.min.js` | 7.9.0 | https://d3js.org/ |
| `tone-14.8.49.min.js` | 14.8.49 | https://tonejs.github.io/ |

These distributions are served locally so imported applications do not depend on a third-party script CDN. Upstream license notices are preserved in adjacent license files. Source maps referenced by upstream builds are for development and are not required at runtime.
